name: Coolify
description: Self-hostable PaaS to deploy apps, databases and services on your own servers.

install:
set -a; . /etc/homemade/env; set +a; rest=${HOMEMADE_URL#https://}; rest=${rest#"$HOMEMADE_PROJECT-$HOMEMADE_VM_NAME"}; rest=${rest%.$HOMEMADE_VM_DOMAIN}; pv() { echo "$HOMEMADE_PROJECT-$HOMEMADE_VM_NAME-$1$rest.$HOMEMADE_VM_DOMAIN"; }; [ -f .env ] || { cp .env.development.example .env; sed -i "s|^APP_KEY=.*|APP_KEY=base64:$(openssl rand -base64 32)|; s|^APP_URL=.*|APP_URL=https://$(pv 8000)|; s|^VITE_HOST=.*|VITE_HOST=$(pv 5173)|" .env; printf 'VITE_PROTOCOL=https
PUSHER_PORT=443
PUSHER_SCHEME=https
' >> .env; }; sed -i 's|clientPort: vitePort|clientPort: 443|; s|origin: `${viteProtocol}://${viteHost}:${vitePort}`|origin: `${viteProtocol}://${viteHost}`|' vite.config.js
docker compose -p coolify -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml build && docker compose -p coolify -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml pull --ignore-buildable

web.cmd: exec docker compose -p coolify -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up
